subject: SAP S/4HANA
supplied_claim_or_inference: All Auto2000 branches targeted for end-2026
verified_finding: The 2025 report gives end-2026 as the target for completion across all Auto2000 branches.
entity_and_time_scope: Auto2000; target disclosed in FY2025 report
limitation: Target is not completion evidence as of 11 November 2026.
research_implication: Treat rollout state as a possible source of branch heterogeneity, not a completed common foundation.

subject: SAP S/4HANA
supplied_claim_or_inference: All Auto2000 branches already fully migrated
verified_finding: No official completion notice was located in the retrieved current-search results; the report only supplies a target.
limitation: Search coverage cannot establish absence. Individual staff profiles were excluded as proof of nationwide completion.
research_implication: Do not predicate analysis on universal migration or universal failure.

subject: SAP S/4HANA
supplied_claim_or_inference: The completed rollout statement applies to Auto2000
verified_finding: The completed integration statement names ASMO3; the Auto2000 statement is a subsequent target.
limitation: These are different sales operations.
research_implication: Keep named business units separate.

subject: Sales Activity Management
supplied_claim_or_inference: SAM already supports dealer sales
verified_finding: Astra reports SAM supporting activity from leads to vehicle unit sales.
limitation: No active-user count, lead completeness or Auto2000 branch usage rate.
research_implication: A proposal for a basic new sales activity tool overlaps a disclosed baseline.

subject: After-sales frontline systems
supplied_claim_or_inference: Reminder Service and MSA already exist
verified_finding: The report identifies Reminder Service and Mobile Service Advisor as after-sales support applications.
limitation: Existence does not establish an EV job-specific workflow, reminder receipt, usable slot inventory or advisor adoption.
research_implication: Separate existing workflow from the unresolved quality of handoffs.

subject: Management analytics
supplied_claim_or_inference: Auto Intelligence already supports monitoring
verified_finding: The report names Auto Intelligence for branch and head-office monitoring.
limitation: No public event schema, customer-outcome attribution or exported dataset.
research_implication: A new generic dashboard requires a distinct decision gap to justify novelty.

subject: Identity and CRM
supplied_claim_or_inference: Single ID / Customer 360 already exists
verified_finding: The 2025 report describes Single ID, consolidated customer interactions, consumer/frontline platforms, analytics and marketing automation.
limitation: An architectural claim is not proof of universally correct linkage or accessible records for every advisor.
research_implication: The relevant hypothesis concerns usable identity at the decision moment rather than the total absence of identity technology.

subject: Identity and CRM
supplied_claim_or_inference: Existing Single ID means customer context is usable in every branch
verified_finding: The annual report does not disclose branch usability, match/error rates, permissions, or how missing/duplicate identities are handled.
limitation: No linked customer-to-work-order microdata or field adoption study.
research_implication: Keep case testimony on difficult usage compatible with reported system existence.

subject: AI
supplied_claim_or_inference: Astra has deployed multiple AI applications
verified_finding: The report describes corporate audit/tax/HR/knowledge tools and separate motorcycle inventory AI; mobile frontline discussion also mentions GenAI.
limitation: These examples do not establish an Auto2000 EV-diagnostic model, consumer recommendation system, model accuracy or economic uplift.
research_implication: Do not transfer group-level AI examples into an Auto2000 EV capability claim.

subject: Motorcycle systems
supplied_claim_or_inference: DMS/NMS/GIS/Smartstock are Auto2000 vehicle systems
verified_finding: The relevant DMS/NMS/GIS and Smartstock passages explicitly concern motorcycle dealers.
limitation: The source provides no basis to assign those exact systems to Auto2000.
research_implication: Exclude cross-business capability leakage.

subject: Single ID history
supplied_claim_or_inference: Single ID would be an entirely new initiative
verified_finding: The 2024 report explicitly describes implementation for Auto2000 and Daihatsu Sales Operation customers.
limitation: Historical existence does not establish 2026 adoption, accuracy or outcomes.
research_implication: The novelty bar for a basic unified customer profile is already high.

subject: EV outlet footprint
supplied_claim_or_inference: 31 Auto2000 outlets provide integrated EV ecosystem service
verified_finding: The FY2025 Toyota section reports 31 Auto2000 outlets with integrated EV ecosystem service.
limitation: No named branch list, service/job matrix, technician roster, battery-test coverage or live appointment capacity.
research_implication: Use 31 as a reported footprint, not 31 interchangeable job-capable service locations.

subject: Charging footprint
supplied_claim_or_inference: Toyota has 118 charging locations
verified_finding: The sidebar totals 118: 113 Toyota dealer locations, two rest-area locations and three mall locations.
limitation: Not 118 Auto2000 sites, not connector count, and not live availability/uptime.
research_implication: Distinguish location coverage from access, compatibility, capacity and operational reliability.

subject: Existing Digiroom scope
supplied_claim_or_inference: Digiroom already has sales and after-sales functions
verified_finding: The report lists new-car purchase, service booking, tracking, test drive and trade-in.
limitation: Feature lists do not verify completion or incremental customer outcomes.
research_implication: Booking, test-drive and trade-in labels alone are not new solution directions.

subject: Loyalty
supplied_claim_or_inference: A new loyalty program would fill a blank baseline
verified_finding: Auto2000 already reports Bronze–Platinum tiers based on transactions and Astrapoints/voucher benefits.
limitation: No eligible base, redemption rate, lift or program-cost evidence here.
research_implication: Any loyalty direction needs a distinct unmet incentive or coverage gap.

subject: TASIA
supplied_claim_or_inference: Auto2000 lacks an existing chatbot
verified_finding: TASIA is reported on website, Digiroom and WhatsApp, including product/service/order/finance information.
limitation: Accuracy, response coverage, human escalation and resolution rates are not established.
research_implication: Generic chatbot novelty is weak; unresolved customer jobs matter more.

subject: OEM digital ecosystem
supplied_claim_or_inference: mTOYOTA and T-Intouch are already present
verified_finding: TAM lists T-Intouch via mTOYOTA, mTOYOTA, TARRA, Halobeng and Toyota Mobile Service.
limitation: Not all are owned by Auto2000; no public permission to reuse data or integrate statuses.
research_implication: Separate ecosystem overlap from legal/technical access.

subject: Trade cycle
supplied_claim_or_inference: Trade Cycle Management and trade-in collaboration are new concepts
verified_finding: TAM reports Trade Cycle Management and used-car trade-in collaboration with OLX.
limitation: No measured retention effect or guaranteed future residual price.
research_implication: The unsolved gap may be valuation evidence or execution rather than absence of trade-in.

subject: OLXmobbi
supplied_claim_or_inference: A Toyota dealer trade-in partner path already exists
verified_finding: OLXmobbi reports expanded trade-in cooperation with Toyota and Daihatsu dealer networks.
limitation: Does not establish each Auto2000 branch agreement, battery-certificate acceptance, shared customer permissions or funded price guarantee.
research_implication: A partner footprint does not automatically confer contracts or residual-risk transfer.

subject: After-free-service economics
supplied_claim_or_inference: Affordable alternative parts and alternative workshops are absent
verified_finding: TAM reports T-OPT for customers after free routine service and OtoXpert as a second workshop channel.
limitation: No public measured cross-channel retention or Auto2000 margin allocation.
research_implication: A lower-price retention option can overlap another existing ecosystem channel.

subject: National market
supplied_claim_or_inference: National car market was about 804k and down 7%
verified_finding: The report states approximately 804 thousand national cars and a 7% decline, citing GAIKINDO.
limitation: Rounded aggregate; retain wholesales/retail and vehicle coverage caveats when combining other series.
research_implication: This is market context, not Auto2000 demand or dealer performance.

subject: Group market share
supplied_claim_or_inference: Astra had 51% national share
verified_finding: The reported 51% is Astra Group car market share.
limitation: Not Toyota-only, not Toyota HEV share, and not Auto2000 share.
research_implication: Keep group, distributor, brand and dealer denominators distinct.

subject: National xEV
supplied_claim_or_inference: National xEV was about 172k, +72%, 22% of cars
verified_finding: The report defines xEV as BEV+HEV+PHEV and reports rounded 172k, +72%, 22%; BEV 13% and HEV 8%.
limitation: Rounded shares do not add exactly to total. Do not overwrite case 175,144 / +69.7% using this number.
research_implication: Preserve conflicting source versions and definitions rather than silently harmonizing.

subject: Toyota and Lexus sales
supplied_claim_or_inference: Toyota and Lexus xEV sold 37,693 in 2024 and 31,668 in 2025
verified_finding: The chart confirms 37,693 and 31,668 xEV, alongside total domestic sales 291,566 and 251,954.
limitation: Dealer volume, installed base and separate HEV/PHEV/BEV counts are not supplied by this chart.
research_implication: Use a brand-portfolio acquisition signal, not an Auto2000 retention measure.

subject: Auto2000 xEV volume
supplied_claim_or_inference: The Toyota/Lexus xEV chart measures Auto2000 xEV sales
verified_finding: The chart is explicitly Toyota and Lexus, not Auto2000.
limitation: No valid dealer conversion factor in this source; case coverage estimate is not a substitute.
research_implication: Do not allocate sales to Auto2000 by an unsupported multiplier.

subject: Electrification penetration
supplied_claim_or_inference: Toyota/Lexus adoption was lower than national adoption
verified_finding: The chart implies xEV sales mix 12.57% in Toyota/Lexus in 2025 versus about 22% reported nationally.
entity_and_time_scope: New-car sales mix, brand portfolio versus market
limitation: This is not owner adoption, not installed-base mix, not matched model/customer demand, and category/channel definitions require alignment.
research_implication: Portfolio availability and national segment mix are plausible rival explanations for sales differences.

subject: Case/source discrepancies
supplied_claim_or_inference: External AR numbers can replace casebook estimates
verified_finding: AR 172k / +72% national and 31,668 Toyota+Lexus differ from friend-reported case 175,144 / +69.7% and approximately 33,950 Toyota.
limitation: The cause of discrepancies is not confirmed; rounding alone is not established. Friend transcription is not a new check of casebook.
research_implication: Preserve casebook as its own competition baseline and flag unresolved external differences.

subject: SAM vendor history
supplied_claim_or_inference: There is a public supplier description of SAM Advance
verified_finding: Suitmedia describes rebuilding Auto2000 SAM as a cross-device web application using core-system interfaces; page labels project 2016–2016.
limitation: Publication date and exact deployment date not established; current code/version/API access and quantified effects unverified.
research_implication: Supports that the basic advisor-tool concept predates this proposal.

subject: Integration feasibility
supplied_claim_or_inference: Existing internal systems are publicly accessible for new work
verified_finding: The sources describe applications and architecture but provide no public APIs, scopes, partner agreements or credentials.
limitation: A referenced interface in a historical vendor story is not present access authorization.
research_implication: Keep solution feasibility conditional on actual permissions and data availability.

subject: Entity roles
supplied_claim_or_inference: TAM and Auto2000 are interchangeable operating units
verified_finding: TAM is the 50/50 Astra–Toyota brand-holder/importer/distributor; Auto2000 is one of its dealers.
limitation: OEM data, dealer systems, finance, insurer and used-car partners have different rights and economics.
research_implication: Shared group affiliation does not consolidate customer promises, budgets or margin ownership.

subject: Battery certificates
supplied_claim_or_inference: The first digital retrieval of a Toyota battery certificate would be new
verified_finding: A current public Toyota HHC route exposes chassis validation, personal details and download stages.
limitation: No VIN entered or certificate obtained; completeness and appraisal acceptance remain unknown.
research_implication: The candidate distinction is consented use in appraisal and useful context, not the first digital certificate.

subject: Service cost guidance
supplied_claim_or_inference: Model-specific service cost guidance does not exist
verified_finding: The current Toyota T-CARE tool shows variant-specific service rows, but its stated estimate basis is March 2024.
entity_and_time_scope: Current public tool with historically dated cost assumptions
limitation: Not a current 2026 invoice or personalized entitlement.
research_implication: Powertrain fit and lifecycle cost guidance may remain distinct from existing tools, with date and scope reconciliation required.

subject: Branch discovery
supplied_claim_or_inference: There is no branch/service-type filtering
verified_finding: The inspected branch panel has a working coarse workshop filter; later model/job filtering was beyond the public walkthrough boundary.
limitation: No whole-site absence claim; no live branch capability certification was measured.
research_implication: A granular model/job match remains a candidate distinction, not a demonstrated missing feature.

subject: BEV trade-in
supplied_claim_or_inference: Auto2000 does not support BEV trade-in
verified_finding: The current public selector allows BZ4X model/year/type before plate entry.
limitation: No price estimate, inspection or battery record acceptance was completed.
research_implication: A candidate needs additional condition evidence or appraisal coordination beyond BEV selection.

subject: Private owner records
supplied_claim_or_inference: Login boundary proves battery/service history is absent
verified_finding: The public account route redirects to login, leaving private records uninspected.
limitation: No account or owner records accessed.
research_implication: Keep record existence, completeness and interoperability unknown.
